title: How to use AI Blocks prompts and get more from them
seoTitle: How to use AI Blocks prompts and get more
description: Use AI Blocks prompts well: fill in the details, give your AI context, improve the answer, ask for truly different versions and turn repeat prompts into skills.
lede: A prompt is one message you paste into your AI for a quick result. This guide shows you how to fill one in properly, improve the answer in a few rounds, ask for versions that really differ, and save the prompts that work.
keywords: turn a prompt into a skill
